<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SNAr reaction where a halide is replaced by an amine, forming a C‑N bond and breaking a C‑X bond. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a halide (functional group “halide”) and form an amine (functional group “amine”), with bonds broken C‑X and bonds formed C‑N.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-X"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
